resources.string: The app needs Bluetooth to talk to your bike.
The app needs the “Nearby devices” permission to find and talk to your bike.
Android won’t ask again. Allow “Nearby devices” for this app in its settings.
No ENGWE bike showed up nearby. Check these, then scan again.
Your bike may be connected to another app or phone
A bike talks to one app at a time. Close the ENGWE app, or turn off Bluetooth on other phones nearby.
This bike doesn’t respond as expected
It doesn’t answer like the bikes this app supports, so the app won’t send it anything.
Your bike stopped responding as expected
The app sends it nothing. Switch the bike off and on, then try again.
The app reads nothing from a bike until you’ve accepted the risks.
The bike didn’t answer within 2\u00A0seconds, so the app can’t tell whether the limit changed.
